# PEN-4446 — make every agent Job state whether its own image carries the GitHub egress wrappers

Tracking: [PEN-4446](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/PEN/issues/PEN-4446)

Recorded here rather than in `PROVENANCE-CHANGES.md`: that file is frozen (BLO-34872) because concurrent appends to it conflict on GitHub's server-side merge and get ejected from the merge queue.

## 1. Initial change

**Files:** `src/server/runtime-pin.ts`, `src/server/runtime-pin.test.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`

PEN-3840 deleted the seven PVC wrapper copies that a **pre-cutover** image fell back to, which is correct for every image built at or after `bb62073a` and a silent PEN-2527 regression for one built before it — `gh` then falls through to `/usr/bin/gh`, which is the image's token wrapper and still supplies a live token, just with no egress scrub. The residual PEN-3840 could not discharge is that the PVC is **shared across companies**, so the population of images that may fall through is not enumerable from any one tenant.

`buildImageWrapperPreflightShell()` makes each Job answer the question for itself: it emits exactly one verdict line to stderr — `ok`, `MISSING`, or `NOT-ON-PATH` — naming `IMAGE_WRAPPER_BIN_DIR`, and is spliced in as the first stage of the container command after `set -o pipefail`.

Three properties decide the shape.

**It asks the image, not the registry.** The alternative — resolve the image tag to a commit and compare ancestry against `bb62073a` — does not work and fails *open*. Measured 2026-10-21: `sha-3ec50bd` carried 150 samples on the shared PVC and resolves to no commit in `Blockcast/paperclip` at all (`compare/bb62073a...3ec50bd` 404, the ref 404, an org-scoped commit search 0 hits), while harbor answers `401` to every credential an agent seat holds. A reference that cannot be placed in history cannot be cleared by ancestry, and `docs/runbooks/pen-3840-retire-pvc-wrapper-generation.md` already says so, naming the filesystem check as *"the authoritative check in every case"*. What it could not provide is a **standing** one: it spells that check as a manual `kubectl exec`, which is only possible while a pod on that reference happens to be Running. `sha-3ec50bd`'s pods are now gone, so that question is permanently unanswerable — the measurement raced the population and lost. Asking at startup removes the race, needs no registry credential, and covers forks and `@sha256:` digest pins because it interrogates a filesystem rather than a reference.

**It checks resolution, not merely presence.** PEN-4357: `job-manifest.ts` makes the directory `PATH[0]` on the *Job env*, but the agent's commands run under shells that re-prepend PVC directories from dotfiles this repo does not own. Presence and victory are separate facts and only the second is the control, so the `ok` arm requires `command -v` to land inside the directory for `gh`, `git` and `github-mcp-server`. `IMAGE_WRAPPER_BINARIES` is deliberately wider than that triple: `github-token-credential-helper` and `paperclip-github-token-env` are chained *by* the `git` wrapper rather than resolved off PATH, so a check written against only the PATH-resolved subset reports `ok` on an image whose `git` wrapper cannot run. That is mutation-tested.

**It reports and does not refuse.** `job-manifest.ts` already settled the disposition at this seam — *"Prepending rather than rejecting: a bad PATH here is an operator misconfiguration that would otherwise fail a Job that has nothing to do with GitHub"* — and reversing that here would be a fleet-wide, cross-company failure mode bought against a hazard no census has yet observed (126/126 clean over 7d at the PEN-3840 entry gate; 4/4 clean live when this landed). Escalating to fail-closed needs its own evidence, namely at least one `MISSING` verdict, which is what this produces. It would also have to be narrower than it looks: denying `git` outright breaks local commits, which are not egress at all.

The snippet always exits 0 and `unset`s its scratch variables, so it cannot perturb the command it is spliced into; both are pinned by tests. One existing guard needed a companion edit: `job-manifest.test.ts` classifies every `git` token in the whole container command and fails closed on anything unrecognised, and the preflight names its binaries as `for` operands, so `git` appears there as a **data value in a list**, never in command position. The exemption is derived from the exported constants rather than written out, so reordering or extending the list carries it along — and it is mutation-tested: adding a genuine unbounded `git fetch origin` to the preflight still reddens that assertion.

## 2. opencode_k8s mirror

**Files:** `src/server/runtime-pin.ts`, `src/server/runtime-pin.test.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`

Mirrored verbatim into this adapter, for the reason PEN-3732 recorded: `IMAGE_WRAPPER_BIN_DIR` is declared in **both** runtime-pin modules and both job-manifests make it `PATH[0]`, so a control that existed in only one of them would report healthy on exactly the Jobs it did not cover. The ordering test here previously asserted the runtime bootstrap sat immediately after `set -o pipefail`; it now asserts the preflight takes that slot and the bootstrap follows it, which is the intended sequence rather than a relaxation — the preflight exports nothing and unsets its own scratch, so it cannot affect the bootstrap it precedes.
